reviews.comment: I've never met somewhere more two faced and dishonest in my life in this school. I hope other students do not suffer like I did.

I 100% recommend taking him. I am a FINC major and he made it so easy. 3 exams (final optional), group project, and quizzes (homework basically). He is hilarious and makes class fun. Definitely had to study, but a breeze compared to 327.

Top 3 professor ever. Super kind and understanding, and actually cares about energy accounting. Tests and quizzes and openbook and if you go up to him during a test, he will tell you if you answer is right or wrong. One group project that he grades leniently. You can tell he cares about the students because he had everyones names memorized by day 3

Really nice, funny guy. Former CFO who really knows what he's talking about. His exam reviews are super helpful because he tells you exactly what kind of questions to expect. He will give extra credit for participation. Go to class, ask questions, and study hard and you'll be fine. 100% take him for 328 above any other prof.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I do not have enough words for how much I appreciate this professor. He made me realize I am not bad at intermediate accounting I just had a bad 327 professor. I made a 100 on one of his exams, I never made over a 75 on previous intermediate class ever. His teaching style allows you to truly learn, I will forever remember DTA and DTLs. THANK YOU!

Harding is a good professor and person. He will help you do well if you put in the effort by attending office hours, exam reviews etc. The exams are very fair and you will do well if you can do all the practice problems posted on canvas. Lectures can be hard to sit through but he understands and tries to make it as engaging as possible.

Best teacher I've had at Texas A&M! Very intriguing and accessible and is a big part of A&M! Makes class enjoyable and just seems very genuine. It's strictly a lecture class, but it's not boring. And come exam time, he is very helpful in getting you prepared! The class itself is easy if you just follow the lecture and do the practice problems.

Goat. One of my favorite professors that I have ever had. He makes accounting somewhat interesting and bearable which is insane. His class is so straightforward you will literally determine what grade you get based on how much you study. If you want an A you can get one and he makes it so doable to achieve.
Took Summer 2023, grades were 85% exams with optional final. Best professor at Mays. Totally fair and entertaining and interesting lectures.

Prof Harding really wants his students to excel in his class. He is always available for office hours and will explain accounting to you in a way it is understandable (even to a finance major like myself). Participation matters... so go to class. Take the man's class!

Prof Harding is a wonderful professor and very kind. The only thing I did not like about his class is the notes are more follow along than they are fill out, so I had trouble keeping my attention. Exams are all 20 multiple choice, comprehensive final. Easy semester long case-study project. 470 total points possible, 400 are exam points.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really tanked the first exam (like most people), but once you realize that this class requires serious attention, it is completely possible to jump back to an A before class ends! Harding will know your name no matter how much you participate, but I recommend participating as much as you can as he gives out random extra credit all year long.

He makes accounting enjoyable to go to. He gives out extra credit in class and is always available to set up office hours. There is one quiz per unit but they are take home and you get unlimited attempts so it is a guaranteed 100. Very knowledgeable with much real world experience. Gotta take him if he is teaching.

Mr. Harding's a beast, he's got that fun uncle vibe to him which makes a boring class more enjoyable. Tests can be tough but there's always fat curves on them if the average is low. Only knock is that he goes really fast in lectures but he's always willing to help outside of class, and gives lots of extra credit. Take him for 328

Professor Harding is one of my favorite professors I have had. He obviously cares about his students and if you care to learn the class will not be too difficult. He gives out extra credit to students who participate in lectures. The material can be a bit tricky but he is willing to offer help to those who need it.
